timetable_intro: Morning, lunchtime, evening and weekend classes make it easy to build yoga into your routine.
categories_intro: Whether you want to build strength, find stillness or simply move, you'll find a class that feels right.
reviews_intro: From first-timers to long-time members, here's what people have to say about practising at Vanessa Flow.
heat_one: We are one of the only studios in the area with infrared heat. It warms your muscles from the inside out, so you move more freely, settle into postures sooner, and go a little deeper without forcing anything. Steady, comfortable warmth, not a wall of heat at the door.
heat_two: Prefer to keep it cool? Plenty of our timetable is unheated, so you can pick the temperature that suits you on the day.
heat_three: New to the heat? For any hot class you need a towel long enough to cover the length of your mat. Rent one at the studio for £4 or buy your own for £28. Bring a bottle of water too, come with a light stomach, and work at your own pace. Beginners are welcome in every heated class.
pregnancy_one: Classes run from 14 weeks to full term, built around the pregnant body. Gentle movement, breath work and relaxation to help you feel strong, calm and ready for birth.
pregnancy_two: Ease the aches, build strength for labour, learn active birthing positions, and pick up breathing techniques that genuinely help on the day. You will meet other mums-to-be along the way, so it is good for your body and your week.
pregnancy_three: Sunday evenings. Suitable from your second trimester onwards. If anything about your pregnancy needs extra care, have a quick word with your midwife or GP first.
